'''Tal Feint''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Force Adept]] who worked as a [[Detective/Legends|private investigator]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Tal Feint was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Detective/Legends|investigator]], concealing his skills with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as he worked on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Hired by [[Zeto/Legends|Zeto]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] frustrated by the strong of [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] wins by [[Dooarix Gyll/Legends|Dooarix Gyll]], Feint watched Gyll and his companion, [[Lisali Mitillan]], for six weeks and recognized Mitillan as a spotter but couldn't figure out how they were communicating.<ref name="EV" />

After their fifth win in six weeks, Zeto escorted Feint to Gyll and Mitillan's stall where Feint interrogated the pair. When Zeto interrupted Feint with a wish of violence against the two racers, Feint watched as Mitillan used the Force to throw Zeto against a wall. Feint used his own [[Mind trick/Legends|power of persuasion]] to send his employer's hired hands away and offered to help Gyll and Mitillan use their Force skills for things greater then fixing races.<ref name="EV" />
